acceptedAnswer.text: JSON-LD (JavaScript Object Notation for Linked Data) is a standardized format recommended by Google to annotate elements on a page, helping search engines understand the meaning and context of your content.

mainEntity.name: How does FAQ schema help search rankings?

acceptedAnswer.text: FAQ schema qualifies your pages for Google Rich Snippets with expandable question accordions, increasing click-through rates (CTR) and search real estate.
